verdict.rationale: Docs show real controls over what gets retained: the cf-aig-collect-log header can disable logging entirely, and cf-aig-collect-log-payload can prevent storage of raw prompt/completion payloads while keeping metrics, explicitly framed as protecting sensitive data (docs-15, docs-25, docs-35). However, there is no documented mechanism for deleting already-stored logs, setting retention time limits, or bulk data-deletion/export controls. Missing for 10: explicit data retention period settings, ability to delete/purge stored logs after the fact, and any data-deletion API or compliance workflow (e.g., GDPR erasure).
